vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft MSCOMCTL.OCX contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution, allowing an attacker to take complete control of an affected system under the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block (SMBv1) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Server Message Block 1.0 (SMBv1) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Edge and Internet Explorer contain a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code in the context of the current user.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows contains an unspecified vulnerability due to the way ws2ifsl.sys (Winsock) handles objects in memory, allowing for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Adobe Flash Player Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: The impacted product is end-of-life and should be disconnected if still in use.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 21-03 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-21-03-mitigate-pulse-connect-secure-product-vulnerabilities) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 21-03. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2019-11510

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Internet Explorer Memory Corruption Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Sophos SFOS SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution if files outside directories configured by Alias-like directives are not under default �require all denied� or if CGI scripts are enabled. The original patch issued under this CVE ID is insufficient, please review remediation information under CVE-2021-42013.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SolarWinds Serv-U Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: DotNetNuke (DNN) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: DotNetNuke (DNN) contains a vulnerability that may allow for remote code execution via cookie deserialization.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix StoreFront Server XML External Entity (XXE) Processing Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix StoreFront Server contains an XML External Entity (XXE) processing vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to retrieve potentially sensitive information.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft MSHTML Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft MSHTML contains a unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: GitHub Community and Enterprise Editions that utilize the ability to upload images through GitLab Workhorse are vulnerable to remote code execution. Workhorse passes image file extensions through ExifTool, which improperly validates the image files.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Drupal Core contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow an attacker to exploit multiple attack vectors on a Drupal site, resulting in complete site compromise.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Use-After-Free Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 21-03 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-21-03-mitigate-pulse-connect-secure-product-vulnerabilities) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 21-03. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-22893

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows Group Policy Preferences Password Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Windows Active Directory contains a privilege escalation vulnerability due to the way it distributes passwords that are configured using Group Policy preferences. An authenticated attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could decrypt the passwords and use them to elevate privileges on the domain.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Win32k Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Win32k kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory which allows for privilege escalation. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to run code in kernel mode.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN contains an improper authentication vulnerability that may allow a user to login successfully without being prompted for the second factor of authentication (FortiToken) if they change the case in their username.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Fortinet FortiOS SSL VPN web portal contains a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to download FortiOS system files through specially crafted HTTP resource requests.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Exchange Server Security Feature Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for security feature bypass.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Netlogon Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Microsoft's Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller. An attacker who successfully exploits the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. The vulnerability is also known under the moniker of Zerologon.
vulnerabilities.notes: Reference CISA's ED 20-04 (https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/ed-20-04-mitigate-netlogon-elevation-privilege-vulnerability-august-2020-patch-tuesday) for further guidance and requirements. Note: The due date for addressing this vulnerability aligns with the requirements outlined in ED 20-04. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2020-1472
